title: Mousambi (Sweet Lime): modeled ₹853/qtl left, Kullu → Palampur
summary: February 2021: reported mousambi (Sweet Lime) prices at Kullu and Palampur imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 22 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹853 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 26 same-variety market pairs screened for mousambi (Sweet Lime) in February 2021; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Palampur report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: February 2021
scenes.caption: Kullu (Himachal Pradesh) and Palampur (Himachal Pradesh) both reported mousambi (Sweet Lime) prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) on 22 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kullu reported a median ₹4,500 per quintal. Palampur reported a median ₹6,000 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,400/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,400 per quintal, and Palampur was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 153 km by road
scenes.caption: 153 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹33/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹741 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹445 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Palampur report, the rule selects 22 of 22 modeled shipping days. 22 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹853 per quintal (₹545 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Mousambi (Sweet Lime) route from Kullu to Palampur was positive on 100% of matched days in February 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹85,300, or ₹54,500 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to mousambi (Sweet Lime)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹33/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Mousambi (Sweet Lime) route from Kullu to Palampur was positive on 100% of matched days in February 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹85,300, or ₹54,500 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
